title: What we learned reading ninety days of our own support inbox
excerpt: Before building Loop we read 4,100 messages by hand. Four things surprised us.
content:
Before building Loop we read 4,100 of our own support messages by hand, with a spreadsheet and too much coffee. It took two people three weeks.

What surprised us

A third of all messages were about four things. Customers rarely named a feature; they described a morning that went wrong. And the loudest requests in our planning meetings barely appeared at all.

Nobody asked for a dashboard. Forty people asked how to answer their manager's question by Monday.

Why this became a product

Reading everything worked, and nobody can afford to do it every quarter. Loop is the reading, done every day.
